title: Lesson 55 - I Forgot to Attach It

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I sent the preview ten minutes ago, but the client says there was no file. I forgot to attach the PDF.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Did you remember to include the shared link?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Yes, I remembered to paste it below my message. But the client says access is denied.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Did you grant view access to the client's address?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I don't remember changing the access settings. I opened the link before sending it, so I thought it worked.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: You were already signed in. Try opening it in a private window.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I've tried that now. It asks me to sign in to my own workspace, so the client can't use it with the access I sent.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Stop editing the slides for a minute to check the recipient address and permission level.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Good point. I don't want to stop editing completely; I just need to pause and verify the delivery.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Exactly. You're stopping to check one detail, not stopping the work for good.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The address is correct. I've granted that named account view access and tested the link while signed out.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What about the attachment?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I've attached a read-only PDF as a backup. I also remembered to rename the file “approved preview v3.”

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Your email subject still says “Draft 2.”

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: You're right. I stopped using vague file names last month, but I forgot to update the subject line this time.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Try adding one sentence that identifies the only current version.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: How about: “The attached PDF and the link below both contain approved preview version 3”?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Clear. Also acknowledge the earlier mistakes rather than asking the client to search again.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: I'll write: “Sorry—the previous message had no attachment, and the link did not include your access. Both issues are fixed below.”

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Good. Send it once, then check the sent copy and wait for confirmation instead of creating another version.
